title: Longest Run of Numbers
statement: Raffle tickets are numbered with integers, in no particular order. Return the length of the longest run of consecutive numbers you hold (for example 4, 5, 6, 7). Duplicates count once. Try to do better than sorting.

answerKey.pattern: Hash set; start counting only at numbers that begin a run
keyPoints: Put every number in a set
A number x starts a run only if x - 1 is not in the set
From each start, count x + 1, x + 2, ... while they are in the set
acceptableSlowerApproaches: Sort and scan neighbours: O(n log n)

hints: Sorting gives O(n log n). Which numbers could start a run?
Put the numbers in a set; x starts a run only if x - 1 is missing.
Counting forward only from run starts keeps the total work O(n).
